decision: BLOCK until admission model fixes; not deployed

findings.issue: Continuation remaining work uses the initial cache-match count, not already computed prefix progress.
findings.evidence: Only schedule_policy.match_prefix_for_req sets num_matched_prefix_tokens; calc_priority processes waiting_queue, not chunked_req; init_next_round_input without tree cache does not update it. Cold prompt200000 with prefix_indices196608 still yields200000 remaining instead of3392.
findings.impact: 124 can park a nearly finished owner as a long/hopeless one; 125 overstates backlog and prolongs relief.
findings.fix: Separate waiting-cache estimates from continuation progress; calculate owner remaining from committed/current prefix, preserving initial cold identity separately.

findings.issue: Rate sample pairs current scheduled batch token count with elapsed time since the previous batch was scheduled.
findings.evidence: _arm_prefill_decode_interval is called by get_next_batch_to_run, before the returned batch executes. An8192-token batch taking0.8s followed by32tokens records40tokens/s instead of10240.
findings.impact: Variable-size prefills bias the trigger; mode changes feed back into mispaired samples.
findings.fix: Store previous batch token count with its start anchor, or use cumulative completed work over a matching wall interval. Reset sampling anchor at flush/idle boundaries while retaining learned rate if desired.

findings.issue: Optional ratio guard is not latched until flush despite documented semantics.
findings.evidence: max_slow1000,ratio.1,min_seen10:2slow/10seen stops; adding11fast without flush makes2/21 and re-enters relief.
findings.impact: Only affects nondefault ratio guard; default absolute40 guard remains monotone.
findings.fix: Latch guard-tripped flag and clear only at reset.

findings.issue: Flush resets relief/counters but keeps the last prefill wall anchor.
findings.impact: First new-level sample includes prior drain/idle/preflight gap, understating rate.
findings.fix: Clear sample anchor/previous tokens at successful flush; retain only EWMA rate.
